code_hints: Before any PLP wait, try clicking consent/geo elements if present: clickFirst(['#onetrust-accept-btn-handler','button:has-text("Accept All")','button:has-text("Continue")','button:has-text("Save and continue")']). Ignore errors if not found.
If landing on homepage or no product tiles after 4-6s, navigate to the first entry_urls PLP, then wait for ['.product-grid','[data-test*="product-card"]'] with a 10-12s timeout.
When extracting PLP, query product_card scope then resolve product_link within each card; de-duplicate absolute hrefs and keep only host www.moncler.com and locale /en-gb/ per url_rules.
On PDP, wait for either title or price selector; if price is loaded via XHR, add a short retry with networkidle or a 500-800ms delay before re-query.
Set Accept-Language header to en-GB to reduce locale gate prompts and unwanted locale redirects.
If redirected to a different locale (regex /en-[a-z]{2}/), rewrite URL to en-gb and reload once; then proceed.
rationale: We landed on the Moncler homepage with no PLP tiles and likely hit a cookie/geo modal. The patch adds robust acceptance selectors for OneTrust and generic continue buttons, plus directs the crawler to known PLP category URLs under en-gb to avoid the non-PLP homepage. PLP/PDP selectors are broadened with data-test and class-based fallbacks commonly used on Moncler/SFCC, increasing chances to detect tiles and prices. URL rules constrain navigation to www.moncler.com, normalize any en-* locale to en-gb, and avoid monclergroup.com or editorial paths that are traps.
